title: Stimulating Avenues: EIB Loans and Returns to Public Investment
title_zh: 激励渠道：欧洲投资银行贷款与公共投资回报
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the macroeconomic effects of persistent public investment shocks using a local-projection instrumental-variables framework and European data. For identification we exploit European Investment Bank loans for public infrastructure projects and address potential endogeneity in loan approval with an inverse-probability-weighted regression-adjustment estimator. Public investment shocks raise employment and output in the medium term, without crowding out private investment and consumption, or generating inflation and additional debt burden. The cumulative output multiplier reaches 3.38 after five years and is significant and larger when credit conditions are favorable. We report significant positive spillover effects from spending in public infrastructure in both output and employment.
abstract_zh: 我们利用局部投影工具变量框架和欧洲数据，研究持续性公共投资冲击的宏观经济效应。为识别因果关系，我们采用欧洲投资银行对公共基础设施项目的贷款数据，并通过逆概率加权回归调整估计量解决贷款审批中的潜在内生性问题。公共投资冲击在中期内提升就业与产出，且不会挤出私人投资与消费，亦不会引发通胀或额外债务负担。五年后累计产出乘数达3.38，在信贷条件有利时该乘数显著且更大。我们报告了公共基础设施支出对产出和就业均存在显著的正向溢出效应。

title: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
title_zh: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距
authors: Huoqing Cao, Chaoran Chen, Xican Xi
abstract: The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。

title: Planning Against Disasters in Dynamic Production Networks
title_zh: 动态生产网络中的灾害应对规划
authors: Vasco Carvalho, Galo Nuño, Vasco Carvalho; Galo Nuño
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In dynamic multisector economies, the planner’s optimal capital allocation can serve to minimize the aggregate impact of shocks cascading through nonlinear production networks. We show analytically in a simplified model that, under complementarity and if risk aversion is not too low, (i) optimal capital allocation under uncertainty involves deliberately over-investing, relative to the deterministic optimum, in upstream sectors in order to mitigate severe economic downturns; (ii) this strategy can reduce the average level of consumption and give rise to a high welfare cost of business cycles. Deploying novel deep-learning techniques in a general environment, we show quantitatively that: (iii) the ergodic distribution of the simulated nonlinear economy features higher mean capital levels in key upstream sectors, lower mean levels of macroeconomic aggregates, realistic aggregate volatility, and a welfare cost of business cycles two orders of magnitude larger than in standard one-sector models.
abstract_zh: 在动态多部门经济中，规划者的最优资本配置能够最小化通过非线性生产网络级联放大的冲击对总体经济的影响。我们在简化模型中通过解析推导表明，在要素互补性且风险厌恶程度不太低的情况下：（i）不确定性下的最优资本配置策略会相对于确定性最优状态，有意对上游部门进行过度投资，以缓解严重的经济衰退；（ii）该策略可能降低平均消费水平，并导致商业周期产生高昂的福利成本。通过运用新型深度学习技术于一般化环境，我们定量分析发现：（iii）模拟非线性经济的遍历分布呈现关键上游部门平均资本水平更高、宏观经济总量均值更低、总体波动率符合现实特征，且商业周期福利成本比标准单部门模型高出两个数量级。

title: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
title_zh: 消费刺激政策的福利与支出效应
authors: Christopher D. Carroll, Edmund Crawley, William Du, Ivan Frankovic, Håkon Tretvoll
abstract: Using a heterogeneous agent model calibrated to match spending dynamics over four years following an income shock (Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)), we assess the effectiveness of three fiscal stimulus policies implemented during recent recessions. Unemployment insurance (UI) extensions are the “bang for the buck” winner when the metric is effectiveness in boosting utility. Stimulus checks are second‐best and have two advantages (over UI): they arrive faster, and are scalable. A temporary (two‐year) cut in wage taxation is considerably less effective than the other policies and has negligible effects in the version of our model without a multiplier.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个异质性主体模型（该模型根据Fagereng、Holm和Natvik（2021）的收入冲击后四年内的支出动态进行校准），评估了近期经济衰退期间实施的三项财政刺激政策的有效性。以提升效用的有效性为衡量标准时，延长失业保险期限是“性价比”最高的政策。刺激性支票次之，并具有两大优势（相较于失业保险）：发放速度更快且具有可扩展性。临时性（为期两年）的工资税削减政策效果远低于其他两项政策，且在我们模型的无乘数版本中影响微乎其微。

title: Impulse Response Analysis of Structural Nonlinear Time Series Models
title_zh: 结构非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应分析
abstract: This paper develops a semiparametric sieve approach to estimate impulse response functions of nonlinear time series models within a broad class of structural autoregressive specifications. A two-step procedure flexibly captures nonlinearities without imposing fixed parametric forms. We establish uniform estimation guarantees and propose an iterative algorithm that makes impulse response computation straightforward. Simulation results show robustness to misspecification with only modest efficiency losses. In an application to U.S. monetary policy, we find larger GDP responses to interest rate hikes than in linear models. We also examine oil supply news shocks of varying magnitudes to assess limitations when analyzing large shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种半参数筛分方法，用于在广泛的结构自回归模型类别中估计非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应函数。该两步法无需设定固定参数形式，即可灵活捕捉非线性特征。我们建立了均匀估计保证，并提出一种迭代算法，使脉冲响应计算变得简便。模拟结果表明，该方法对模型误设具有稳健性，且仅带来适度的效率损失。在应用于美国货币政策时，我们发现利率上调对GDP的影响大于线性模型的结果。此外，我们考察了不同幅度的石油供给新闻冲击，以评估分析大规模冲击时的局限性。
